import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem combined_projection_is_open_bijective {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
  (π₁ : X × Y → X)
  (π₂ : X × Y → Y)
  (h₁ : π₁ = Prod.fst)
  (h₂ : π₂ = Prod.snd) :
  IsOpenMap (fun p : X × Y => (π₁ p, π₂ p)) ∧
    Function.Bijective (fun p : X × Y => (π₁ p, π₂ p)) := by
  subst h₁ h₂
  change IsOpenMap id ∧ Function.Bijective id
  exact ⟨fun s hs => by rwa [Set.image_id], Function.bijective_id⟩
